en.headline: John Lee to visit Beijing and Shanghai for symposium and CIIE
en.dek: The Chief Executive departs tomorrow for the 29th Beijing-Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium and the ninth China International Import Expo, returning on November 6.
body: Chief Executive John Lee will leave for Beijing and Shanghai on Tuesday to attend the 29th Beijing-Hong Kong Economic Cooperation Symposium and the ninth China International Import Expo, the government announced on Monday.

Lee said Hong Kong would continue to deepen exchanges with the Mainland. By taking part in the events, the city would promote its role as a connector and value-adder under “one country, two systems” and support Mainland enterprises going global while bringing in overseas firms.

In Beijing he will meet local officials and speak at the symposium’s opening on November 4 under the theme “Beijing-Hong Kong Together into the 15th Five Year Plan”. He will then travel to Shanghai to attend the CIIE opening and Hongqiao International Economic Forum on November 5, visit Hong Kong exhibitors, and meet Shanghai officials.

Lee is scheduled to return on November 6. Chief Secretary Chan Kwok-ki will act as Chief Executive during his absence. The announcement was issued by the Information Services Department at noon on Monday.

zh.headline: 李家超明赴北京上海出席京港洽談會及進博會
zh.dek: 行政長官周二出發，出席第29屆京港經濟合作研討洽談會及第9屆中國國際進口博覽會，預計11月6日返港。
body: 政府周一公布，行政長官李家超將於周二前往北京及上海，出席第29屆北京·香港經濟合作研討洽談會及第9屆中國國際進口博覽會。
李家超表示，香港會繼續深化與內地的交流合作。參與活動有助發揮「一國兩制」下「超級聯繫人」及「超級增值人」角色，支持內地企業「走出去」及引入海外企業。
在北京期間，他會與當地官員會面，並於11月4日在主題為「京港共進十五五」的洽談會開幕禮致辭。同日轉赴上海，11月5日出席進博會開幕及虹橋國際經濟論壇，參觀香港展區及企業擦位，並與上海官員會晤。
李家超預計11月6日返港。離港期間由政務司司長陳國基署任行政長官。有關公告由新聞處於周正午發出。
